name: omnilab/pbdb
description: Omnilab PBDB: a taxon of the Paleobiology Database, fossil or living, by its number or name - rank, accepted name, common name, extant or not, first and last appearances (intervals and ages in Ma), occurrences counted, classification, ecology, reference - a fossil occurrence by its number, a search of names, and the fossil occurrences of a place and an age (outside the contract: an age is no date), through the PBDB data service 1.2, no key needed.
